{n} 台等对端上线.other: {n} waiting for the devices to come online

已从收件人移除「{name}」（不是踢人，对方不会收到任何通知）: Removed “{name}” from the recipients (this is not a kick; the device is not notified)
参与者只剩一台，已退回一对一会话: Only one participant is left; switched back to a one-to-one conversation
这台设备已经不在设备表里了，会话已关闭: This device is no longer in the device list; the conversation has been closed

其他 {n} 台设备 · 已有 {m} 条消息在等你.one: Plus {n} other device · {m} messages already waiting for you
其他 {n} 台设备 · 已有 {m} 条消息在等你.other: Plus {n} other devices · {m} messages already waiting for you

「{from}」邀请你加入群聊「{name}」: “{from}” invites you to join the group “{name}”
用「＋ 新建会话」选设备开始，或到「设备」页那一行点「发消息」；对方先发来消息也: Start with “+ New conversation” and pick devices, or tap “Message” on a row in the Devices page; messages another device sends first show up here too.

还有 {n} 条来自其他会话的消息，回会话列表.one: {n} message from other conversations. Back to conversations
还有 {n} 条来自其他会话的消息，回会话列表.other: {n} messages from other conversations. Back to conversations

单向发送，对方各自单独收到: one-way sending; each device gets its own copy
任意参与者共享同一条消息流: every participant shares a single message stream
{label} · {state} · 已拒绝加入这个群，收不到群消息: {label} · {state} · declined to join this group and won't receive group messages
再加几台：选到两台以上就成为一个多台会话（群发或群聊）: Add more devices: pick two or more to turn this into a multi-device conversation (broadcast or group)

有 {n} 条消息未能同步（来源设备不在线）.one: {n} message couldn't be synced (the source device is offline)
有 {n} 条消息未能同步（来源设备不在线）.other: {n} messages couldn't be synced (the source device is offline)

你发出的每条消息都会作为单独的一对一消息，分别送达 {n} 台设备；这里只显示你.one: Each message you send goes out as a separate one-to-one message to {n} device; only your own messages are shown here.
你发出的每条消息都会作为单独的一对一消息，分别送达 {n} 台设备；这里只显示你.other: Each message you send goes out as a separate one-to-one message to {n} devices; only your own messages are shown here.

在这里说一句，名册上的成员都会看到（同一条消息流）；传文件则按成员逐台推送。: Say something here and every member on the roster sees it (one shared stream); files are pushed to each member individually.
发一条消息或传一个文件，开始和设备对话。: Send a message or a file to start talking with your devices.
接收时选保存位置: choose where to save it when accepting
群里说的话，名册上的成员都会看到；图片也可以直接粘进来: Everything you say here is seen by all roster members; you can also paste images directly
图片可以直接粘进来（{shortcut}），前后还能继续写文字: You can paste images directly ({shortcut}) and keep typing around them
选文件发到群里：按成员逐台推送（未配对的成员各自点一次同意）: Pick files to send to the group: each member gets its own push (unpaired members must accept once)
选文件发过去就是推送: Sending the files you pick pushes them
松手即发送到这条会话: Release to send to this conversation
勾选一台设备时为单独会话；勾选两台以上才启用模式。: Selecting one device gives a one-to-one conversation; the mode only applies with two or more.
只显示你发出的消息；每台设备各自收到一条单独的一对一消息 —— 互相看不到，对方: Only your own messages are shown; each device receives a separate one-to-one message — they can't see each other, and their replies don't come back here (each reply lands in its own conversation with you). Every device has to accept once, except paired devices with "Auto-receive from paired devices" on.
群里任意一台设备发送的消息，所有参与者都能看到（同一条消息流）。收到邀请的人点「: Messages sent by any device in the group are visible to every participant (one shared stream). An invitee only becomes a member after choosing “Join”; leaving affects only you (the local record is deleted too, and the other members are unaffected).
模式不可更改（改了历史就成了两半），移除到只剩一台时会退回单独会话。: The mode can't be changed (it would split the history); removing devices until one is left falls back to a one-to-one conversation.
留空则显示设备名称: Leave empty to show device names
还没有设备：先到「设备」页添加，或等局域网里的设备出现。: No devices yet: add one on the Devices page, or wait for devices on your LAN to appear.
拿这份名单建一个群，之后的讨论共享同一条消息流。历史不迁移：已经发出的消息仍在各: Create a group from this list so later discussion shares one message stream. History is not migrated: messages already sent stay in each device's separate conversation (the peers never knew they belonged to a group).
删除群发（消息留在各设备会话）: Delete broadcast (messages stay on each device)
退出群聊（本地删除并广播离开）: Leave group (delete locally and announce it)
只清本机记录：设备行、地址、备注与观察指纹；对端不受影响。它下次广播时还会重新出: Clears local records only: the device row, address, remark and observed fingerprint. The device is unaffected and will reappear on its next broadcast.
LocalSend 会话只支持文件，用右侧＋发送: LocalSend conversations support files only — use the + on the right to send
LocalSend 会话只支持文件，用下方「＋」发送: LocalSend conversations support files only — use the “+” below to send
发送文件到 LocalSend 设备: Send files to the LocalSend device
选文件发给这台 LocalSend 设备（对方确认后接收）: Pick files to send to this LocalSend device (the other side must accept them)
LocalSend 文字消息；图片和文件用右侧＋发送: LocalSend text message; use the + on the right to send images and files
LocalSend 会话可以发文字；图片和文件用下方「＋」发送: LocalSend conversations support text; use the “+” below for images and files
LocalSend 会话可以发文字/图片；普通文件用下方「＋」发送: LocalSend conversations support text and images; use the “+” below for ordinary files
